# Images that .github/workflows/ci-image-scan.yml scans and reports, but that do
# NOT fail the merge on a HIGH or CRITICAL finding.
#
# This file exists so that every exemption is visible in one place, and so that
# a pull request which adds one changes a file whose only subject is exemptions.
# A `blocking: false` buried in a matrix is easy to miss in review.
#
# An image belongs here only when BOTH of these hold:
#
#   1. No branch here can make the job green on its own — either because the
#      whole finding set is owned outside this repository, or because a part of
#      it is and that part alone still fails the threshold.
#   2. There is a recorded path that ends the exemption.
#
# Criterion 1 used to read "the finding set is owned outside this repository",
# full stop. elitea-worker-python widened it, deliberately and visibly: most of
# its findings come from a Debian base with no fix published, while a smaller
# part was ours and fixable. Under the old wording that image had no honest
# home — it could not block (the base findings make every branch red) and it
# could not be exempt (the rest were ours). The wording now describes the mixed
# case, and the retirement issue is what keeps it from being a hiding place: it
# names the fixable part. #554 has since bumped that part, and the entry below
# records exactly what is left and who owns it.
#
# Name both issues on the line above the entry: the findings, and the path that
# ends the entry. Delete the entry when that path completes.
#
# What an entry does NOT do:
#
#   - it does not change the HIGH,CRITICAL threshold;
#   - it does not suppress a CVE, and the full count is still printed;
#   - it does not relax the dormancy guards. A missing report, or a report
#     without the expected target type, still FAILS the job;
#   - it does not survive its cause. The job FAILS when an exempt image reports
#     zero findings, because the entry is then stale.
#
# The scan matrix in ci-image-scan.yml must set `blocking: false` for exactly
# these names. The coverage job fails when the two files disagree.
#
# Lines that start with # are comments. Blank lines are ignored.

# findings #553 — RE-MEASURED 2026-09-06 on cold local builds (trivy 0.74.0,
#   --severity HIGH,CRITICAL, the scan job's settings). 101 lines, 7 CRITICAL
#   and 94 HIGH: 82 from the Debian base and 19 in site-packages. Before this
#   change the same measurement read 120 lines (84 Debian, 36 Python).
#
#   The Debian half has NO published fixed version for any of the 82, on either
#   base: bookworm reported 84 and trixie 82. That half satisfies criterion 1
#   and is why the entry stays.
#
#   The Python half is now 19, and 17 of the 19 are three packages that
#   elitea-sdk 0.9.8 pins in its OWN base dependencies, not in this repository:
#     pillow 11.1.0 (13 lines) — SDK `pillow~=11.1.0`, fixes start at 12.1.1
#     starlette 0.45.3 (3)     — SDK `fastapi==0.115.9`, which caps starlette<0.46
#     h11 0.14.0 (1)           — SDK `httpcore==1.0.7`, which caps h11<0.15
#   A resolver refuses every attempt to raise them, so those 17 are also owned
#   outside this repository. The last 2 are nltk CVE-2026-81726 (no fixed
#   version published) and unstructured CVE-2026-71428 (fixed in 0.24.0, which
#   states beautifulsoup4>=4.14.3, psutil>=7.2.2 and charset-normalizer>=3.4.4 —
#   a closure move under every indexing family, so it waits for a parity run).
# retirement #554 — the 11 fixable packages named in #553 are bumped (see
#   services/elitea-worker-python/pyproject.toml). What is left needs an
#   elitea-sdk release that raises pillow, fastapi and httpcore, plus the
#   unstructured 0.24.0 parity run. Delete this line and flip blocking to true
#   when the image reports zero.
#
#   RE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-07 without a build: the resolved site-package closure
#   (uv pip compile over the pinned SDK plus [agent-current,indexing-current])
#   scanned with `trivy fs` reports the SAME 19 lines and the SAME split —
#   pillow 13, starlette 3, h11 1, nltk 1, unstructured 1 — and uv refuses
#   pillow==12.3.0, starlette==0.49.1 and h11==0.16.0 by naming the three SDK
#   pins. The Debian half was NOT re-measured: that needs the image.
#
#   SIZE OF THE unstructured MOVE, measured the same way. Raising the three
#   floors DOES resolve, but unstructured 0.24.0 changes its own BASE
#   dependencies: it adds spacy>=3.7, numba>=0.60, filelock, installer and
#   regex, and drops nltk and backoff. In this closure that is 25 new
#   distributions — spacy with blis/thinc/cymem/preshed/murmurhash/catalogue/
#   srsly/wasabi/weasel/confection/cloudpathlib/typer/rich, and numba with
#   llvmlite. The parity run is therefore not a three-floor bump: it swaps the
#   tokenizer stack under every indexing family and adds an LLVM JIT to the
#   image. Size it before taking it.
elitea-worker-python

# findings #635 — RE-MEASURED 2026-09-06 on a cold local build of the shipping
#   image (trivy 0.74.0, --severity HIGH,CRITICAL, the scan job's settings):
#   54 lines, 3 CRITICAL and 51 HIGH. ALL 54 are Debian base packages, NONE is
#   in this project's own packages, and trivy publishes NO fixed version for
#   any of them, so the --only-upgrade list in the Containerfile has nothing to
#   add. The entry was written at 16; util-linux (CVE-2026-76642, -78408,
#   -78409, -78410 across nine binary packages) and systemd (CVE-2026-16742)
#   were published after that measurement. The base is unchanged and is the
#   newest python:3.12-slim.
# retirement #636 — re-measure on each base bump. perl-base is 8 of the 54, so
#   removing it no longer ends this entry on its own; the entry ends when
#   Debian ships the fixes.
elitea-deepwiki

# findings #635 — the SAME cause as elitea-deepwiki above, not a second one:
#   this image is the same python:3.12.14-slim base with the same
#   --only-upgrade of the three packages Debian trixie has a fix for, so its
#   HIGH/CRITICAL findings are that base's findings. It is listed separately
#   because the register is keyed by image and a shared entry would hide which
#   images are exempt.
# retirement #636 — the same path ends both: the base bump that fixes them, or
#   removing perl-base. Re-measure this image at the same time, and delete both
#   lines together.
elitea-inventory
